{
  "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently below true outcomes, showing 1-3 dollar lag that widens in later periods",
    "True outcomes exhibit clear mean reversion from extremes, pulling forecasts upward and inward",
    "Sentiment positively correlates with price momentum but model under-reacts to sentiment shifts",
    "Price volatility increases in true outcomes vs forecasts, especially after day 15 in 30d horizons",
    "Model lacks price magnitude sensitivity, producing flat forecasts when history shows 1+ dollar daily movement",
    "Sentiment turning negative has muted effect on model forecasts relative to actual price pullbacks",
    "Forecasts fail to capture inflection points where price direction reverses within the 30-day horizon"
  ]
}
